stem: A grower waters every morning, but containers are staying wetter each day and plant demand has slowed. What is the strongest response?
choices: Use root-zone condition and dryback trend to reassess irrigation timing instead of following the clock
Continue the same schedule because daily watering is always correct
Increase nutrient concentration without checking moisture
Ignore the trend until wilting occurs
rationale: Irrigation frequency should respond to substrate, roots, plant demand, and environment rather than a fixed ritual.
